item.title: Does God punish children for their father’s sins? (Data Over Dogma)
item.description:
#maklelan3564
A portion of a Data Over Dogma episode in which Dan Beecher and I put the Bible against the Bible on generational curses: the Ten Commandments’ punishment ‘to the third and fourth generation’, the other places that repeat it, Ezekiel 18’s insistence that a child shall not suffer for the iniquity of a parent, and how Deuteronomy 7 answers Deuteronomy 5.
Full episode on YouTube: Are Generational Curses Actually Biblical? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5BbqHFylVQ4 New Data Over Dogma episodes every week: https://www.youtube.com/@dataoverdogma
0:00 Bible vs. Bible 1:30 Exodus 20: the Ten Commandments 2:59 The other Ten Commandments 4:55 To the third and fourth generation 7:56 Ezekiel 18: the child shall not suffer 9:26 Dating the texts 10:23 Deuteronomy 5 vs. Deuteronomy 7

item.title: Was Aaron’s rod an Asherah pole? (Data Over Dogma)
item.description:
#maklelan3563
A portion of a Data Over Dogma episode in which Dan Beecher and I look at the argument that Aaron’s budding rod was an Asherah pole kept in the temple, what was really in or near the Ark of the Covenant, what that means for Moses striking the rock in Numbers 20, and why some scholars connect the menorah with Asherah.
Full episode on YouTube: Was Aaron’s Rod an Asherah Pole? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ztWPrcKRSFg New Data Over Dogma episodes every week: https://www.youtube.com/@dataoverdogma
0:00 A stylized tree in the temple? 1:29 Who was Asherah? 1:56 Aaron’s rod as an Asherah pole 3:09 What was in the Ark? 4:48 Numbers 20: Moses strikes the rock 8:18 A sign of authority 10:10 Divine images in the temple 11:05 The menorah and Asherah 12:29 Why Moses didn’t enter the Promised Land

item.title: All about crucifixion (Data Over Dogma)
item.description:
#maklelan3562
A portion of a Data Over Dogma episode in which Dan Beecher and I look at Roman crucifixion: who was crucified and why, whether Jesus died on a T-shaped cross or a stake, what the Puteoli and Alexamenos graffiti and an ancient dream book show, why condemned people carried only the crossbeam, and why crucifixion was meant to be shameful.
Full episode on YouTube: Don’t Get Cross With Me https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FL5YxTKUioI New Data Over Dogma episodes every week: https://www.youtube.com/@dataoverdogma
0:00 Who got crucified, and why 2:20 Cross or stake? The word stauros 3:19 The Puteoli graffito 4:25 The Alexamenos graffito 5:55 An ancient dream book 7:41 Carrying the crossbeam 8:43 The sign above his head 10:05 A deliberately shameful death
